Undulator Operation: Standard FEL Tuning Procedure

After Shut-Downs (twice per year) Each delivery run (weekly)
1) Beam Based Alignment 1) Optimize Accelerator: Emittance, Dispersion,
2) Adjust Undulator mid-plain to BBA Orbit using (K- Compression, Orbit, Matching, Laser Heater
Mono) 2) Establish initial SASE level
3) Measure and Correct Undulator K-Offsets (K-Mono) 3) Fine tune linear taper in gain regime and optimize
4) Measure and apply Wakefield compensating linear quadratic taper by maximizing power
taper 4) Empirical fine tuning (for power) at each undulator gap

setting, wavelength tune-ability suffers but intensity gains
5) Adjust pointing
